title: Toronto Express Canadian Food Tour: 90 Min with Our Founder
includes: All gratuities (we don't accept tips) - please go shopping at our friends.
Stop #1: Carousel Bakery - Peameal Bacon Sandwich, just like the way Bourdain and Emeril loved it.
Stop #3 - Sweetie Pie Bakery: Poutine, topped with Montreal smoked-meat with your Iced London Fog.
90-minute guided walking tour with a Chopsticks+Forks Culinary Storyteller
Stop #2 - Eve's Temptations: Nanaimo Bar, a West Coast birth but a Canadian favourite. A Must!
Priority entry at every stop — you will not queue
Stop #4 - Tartistry: Scotch Butter Tart - A "Distillery District Only" butter tart with scotch.
Time for shopping or exploring - We do not rush, but we keep the pace where each restaurant expects (not included)
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness

Mobility: Due to the uneven "Cobblestone Roads" for a good portion of our tour with over 1 km of walking over 1.5 hours - This Experience is not recommended for people that have mobility difficulties.
policies: Our friends cook their family recipes as they always have, so we can't accommodate gluten, dairy, or nut allergies, and we don't offer a vegan option. Vegetarian and pescatarian versions are available — just tell us when you book.
Halal/Kosher guests: Unfortunately, due to the Express nature of this tour, we can only offer you our Vegetarian option. Please advise at booking.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Ninety minutes with Jusep Sim — Toronto's culinary insider and founder of the award-winning Chopsticks+Forks. No lines: these shops are his friends, we walk in, they feed us, and no money changes hands — not at the counters, not with him. He doesn't accept gratuity. If you loved it, spend it here, on them.

Seven Canadian must-eats and sips across four iconic stops, from St. Lawrence Market — first on National Geographic's top 10 food markets list — to the cobblestone lanes of the Distillery District.

You'll taste: the "Original" peameal bacon sandwich with maple syrup at Carousel Bakery, a Nanaimo bar at Eve's Temptations, poutine with Montreal smoked meat and an iced London Fog at Sweetie Pie, and a "scotch" butter tart at Tartistry.

Bringing kids or grandparents? Built for you — flat ground, an easy pace, and a menu picky eaters love. Children 2–12 book at a reduced rate. Travelling with teens? Message us — we'll make you the coolest parents on the trip.
